issues.legal_issue: A court considering bail under Section 43D(5) of the UAPA must examine the charge-sheet material as a whole, taken as it is, to determine whether reasonable grounds exist for believing the accusations are prima facie true, without conducting a mini-trial.
The charge-sheet material did not provide reasonable grounds for believing that the accusations of UAPA offences against the accused were prima facie true, making him entitled to bail.
Bail must be granted when the applicable statutory conditions are satisfied, and refusing bail in a deserving case violates the accused’s rights under Article 21.
